ModMetaData.name: Toolkit Utilities 2.0e
ModMetaData.author: Captolamia
ModMetaData.description:
⚡ **ToolkitUtils 2.0e - Enhanced Twitch Commands** ⚡
**REQUIRES both ToolkitCore 2.0e AND Twitch Toolkit 2.0e!**
Supercharge your Twitch integration! This essential expansion adds advanced commands, improved viewer feedback, and quality-of-life enhancements to complete your Twitch Toolkit experience.
**Features:** • Updated TwitchLib 3.4.0 integration • Enhanced viewer feedback systems • Advanced command repertoire • Improved chat interaction • Streamer quality-of-life tools
**This mod completes the Twitch Toolkit 2.0e trilogy!** For the full experience, ensure you have all three mods installed in this order: 1. 🏗️ ToolkitCore 2.0e (Foundation) 2. 🎮 Twitch Toolkit 2.0e (Main Features) 3. ⚡ ToolkitUtils 2.0e (Enhanced Commands) ← YOU ARE HERE!
**⚠️ INCOMPATIBLE with older TwitchToolkit versions!**
**Report Issues:** https://github.com/ekudram/toolkit-utils/issues
